name: Low Power Mode, Battery Saver and Background App Refresh state
plain: Apps can see whether the phone is in a power saving state and adapt, and iOS shows if background refresh is on.
meaning: Reveals whether the person is low on battery or has background activity disabled. Apps use it to defer work; it also hints at device habits.

android.note: Battery Saver restricts background activity, location and sync

ios.note: Low Power Mode pauses background fetch, mail fetch and some animations; backgroundRefreshStatus is available, restricted, denied

limits.headline: Can see if your phone is saving power, and slow itself down to match
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks this when it opens or before it starts background work
can: Tell if Low Power Mode or Battery Saver is on
Check on iPhone whether Background App Refresh is available, restricted or turned off
Pause syncing, animations or downloads to save battery
cannot: Turn Low Power Mode or Battery Saver on or off for you
Force background work to continue when the system has paused it
Change your Background App Refresh setting
limits.reach_label: A simple on or off check
limits.differs: iPhone Low Power Mode pauses background fetch and mail fetch. Android Battery Saver restricts background activity, location and sync.

story.what_it_is: Apps can tell if your phone is saving power, and iPhone shows if background refresh is on.

marketing.name: Low Power Mode
marketing.pitch: Apple pitches Low Power Mode as a way to stretch battery by reducing background activity and some visual effects.

marketing.name: Battery Saver
marketing.pitch: Google describes Battery Saver as a mode that extends battery life by limiting background activity.

story.for_you: You never see apps read it. But when your battery is low, games look a little plainer and apps stop syncing, because they noticed you switched on power saving.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to be kind to the battery, such as lowering frame rate or delaying uploads. Others can read it as a hint about habits, like someone who is often low on charge.

use_cases.example: A racing game drops from 60 to 30 frames per second when it sees Low Power Mode, so you can keep playing longer.
A streaming app picks a lower video quality and stops downloading ahead when battery saving is on.
A navigation app dims the map animation but keeps directions going.
An ad network sees many low battery devices and avoids heavy video ads that would drain them.
A product team splits crash and speed reports by power mode to find problems only seen when saving power.
A fraud tool notes whether the device state looks normal for the account holder.

story.android_note: Battery Saver limits background work, location and sync.
story.ios_note: Low Power Mode pauses background fetch and mail. Apps can also see if Background App Refresh is on, off or limited.

technical_bounds: Both are readable with no prompt

history.change: Low Power Mode and isLowPowerModeEnabled introduced
